nodes.description: external initializer entry point of MATTER2; initializes Context, ERC20 metadata and delegates to __MATTER_init_unchained to mint the full token allocation.
public initializer that mints fixed allocations (24M/1M/10M/10M/50M/5M) of MATTER tokens to the six provided addresses.
offering allocation recipient passed into __MATTER_init.
public allocation recipient passed into __MATTER_init.
team allocation recipient passed into __MATTER_init.
fund allocation recipient passed into __MATTER_init.
mining allocation recipient passed into __MATTER_init.
liquidity allocation recipient passed into __MATTER_init.
offering allocation recipient used by the mint of 24,000,000 tokens.
public allocation recipient used by the mint of 1,000,000 tokens.
team allocation recipient used by the mint of 10,000,000 tokens.
fund allocation recipient used by the mint of 10,000,000 tokens.
mining allocation recipient used by the mint of 50,000,000 tokens.
liquidity allocation recipient used by the mint of 5,000,000 tokens.
IERC20 token being vested/timelocked; source of balanceOf accounting for the unlock schedule.
address receiving unlocked tokens in unlock().
timestamp at which the vesting schedule starts; compared against block.timestamp.
total duration of the vesting schedule used in the capacity formula.
number of unlock tranches used to divide span in the capacity loop.
snapshot of the token balance at start(), used to compute the already-vested amount.
governance-gated external function that configures token, recipient, begin, span, times and snapshots total balance.
public view computing the currently unlockable amount from begin/span/times/total and block.timestamp (now).
public function transferring unlockCapacity() tokens to recipient via SafeERC20 safeTransfer.
external fallback that unconditionally triggers unlock(), allowing token release to be triggered by any plain call.
token address assigned to the token state variable in start().
recipient address assigned to the recipient state variable in start().
vesting start timestamp assigned to begin in start().
vesting span assigned to span in start().
number of tranches assigned to times in start().
block.timestamp (now) used as the vesting clock in unlockCapacity; miner-influenceable and drives the transfer amount.
external IERC20 safeTransfer(recipient, unlockCapacity()) call in unlock(), reachable from fallback(); potential callback/reentrancy gateway.
external IERC20 balanceOf(address(this)) call used in unlockCapacity and in start() snapshotting the total balance.
loop counter over the vesting tranches 1..times in unlockCapacity.

edges.reason: __MATTER_init calls __MATTER_init_unchained to perform the allocation mints.
offering_ parameter flows into the initializer entry point.
public_ parameter flows into the initializer entry point.
team_ parameter flows into the initializer entry point.
fund_ parameter flows into the initializer entry point.
mine_ parameter flows into the initializer entry point.
liquidity_ parameter flows into the initializer entry point.
offering_ parameter is used as the recipient of the 24,000,000 token mint.
public_ parameter is used as the recipient of the 1,000,000 token mint.
team_ parameter is used as the recipient of the 10,000,000 token mint.
fund_ parameter is used as the recipient of the 10,000,000 token mint.
mine_ parameter is used as the recipient of the 50,000,000 token mint.
liquidity_ parameter is used as the recipient of the 5,000,000 token mint.
_token parameter is consumed by start() when assigning the token state variable.
_recipient parameter is consumed by start() when assigning recipient.
_begin parameter is consumed by start() when assigning begin.
_span parameter is consumed by start() when assigning span.
_times parameter is consumed by start() when assigning times.
governance-gated start() writes the token state variable; configuration is privileged.
governance-gated start() sets the payout recipient; compromised governance can redirect unlocks.
governance-gated start() sets begin, the timestamp gate controlling when tokens unlock.
governance-gated start() sets span, controlling the unlock schedule length.
governance-gated start() sets times, controlling the number of tranches.
governance-gated start() snapshots total balance used by the vesting formula.
the token passed to start() is queried via balanceOf(address(this)) to snapshot total.
begin is compared against now inside unlockCapacity to gate vesting.
span is multiplied/divided in the unlockCapacity vesting computation.
times bounds the tranche loop and divides span in unlockCapacity.
total is used to subtract the not-yet-vested amount in unlockCapacity.
loop counter i drives the tranche comparison inside unlockCapacity.
block.timestamp (now) is the miner-influenceable clock that decides how much capacity is unlocked.
the token state variable is the target of the external balanceOf(address(this)) call.
unlockCapacity performs the external token.balanceOf call on every invocation.
unlock() calls unlockCapacity() to compute the amount to transfer.
the amount returned by unlockCapacity flows into the safeTransfer call.
the recipient state variable is the destination of the safeTransfer call.
unlock() makes an external SafeERC20 transfer to recipient; a malicious token/recipient can re-enter before value settles.
fallback() unconditionally invokes unlock(), making token release triggerable by any plain call.
start() chooses the token/recipient pair that unlock() later pays out through safeTransfer.
